policy: Specification Quality Gate before UI automation
blockingRule: High and Medium issues block automation unless explicitly deferred by human review.

requiredSpecSections.heading: Specification Objective
requiredSpecSections.reason: Automation must have a clear objective.

requiredSpecSections.heading: Acceptance Criteria
requiredSpecSections.reason: Automation must verify explicit acceptance criteria.

requiredSpecSections.heading: Risk Focus
requiredSpecSections.reason: Risk focus explains why this test matters.

requiredSpecSections.heading: Boundary Conditions
requiredSpecSections.reason: Boundary behavior must be visible before automation.

requiredSpecSections.heading: Error Cases
requiredSpecSections.reason: Exception behavior must be clear or explicitly out of scope.

requiredSpecSections.heading: Boundary Statement
requiredSpecSections.reason: The test must preserve black-box and security boundaries.

restrictedScope: automatic defect creation without human review
